thread:
elaine.cs: Quick health check on AceroLabs onboarding. Noticed p95 spikes during peak and token cost up ~41% over 48h.
ravi.se: What model and route are they on today?
elaine.cs: Hosted default -> open-3b v1. Error rate is fine but tail latency is hurting their demo flow.
marta.ml: Suggest a conservative canary: open-3b-q8 (INT8) at 5% with automatic fallback. Should cut cost ~30% and reduce p50. Need to validate quality on their prompt set.
ken.aceroops: Acero team ok with small quality delta if cost/latency improves. Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, so results matter.
ava.cs: Noted. If we deliver >=20% cost savings with stable UX, we add this into renewal playbook.
ravi.se: I can add a canary route with weighted rollout and health checks. Need: prompt corpus, quality KPIs, preferred canary window.
elaine.cs: Dropping proto prompts and dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/acero/onboard/latency
elaine.cs: Proposed plan:
1) Eval on 500 prompts Wed night
2) Canary Thu 10:00 PST -> 5% open-3b-q8, weight shift if green
3) Prefix caching for repeated prefixes
4) Small in-app survey for canary traffic ("response helpful?")
5) Auto-rollback if QA pass rate drops >1% or error increases
marta.ml: Eval spec: BLEU, semantic-sim, and internal QA heuristics. Thresholds: rollback if semantic sim drops >2% or QA pass <98% of baseline.
ravi.se: I'll prepare route config and rollout playbook. Plan to add auto-rollback webhook to #eng-runtime and trigger infra-bot.
infra-bot: Staging canary route created: acero-quant-canary-stg (cr-00192). Health checks OK.
ken.aceroops: We have a release freeze Wed night; prefer canary Thu 10:00 PST. Acero ops confirmed.
ava.cs: I'll draft a short customer note highlighting the experiment and renewal talking points.
marta.ml: Quick heads-up: also test a distilled open-1.5b path for short/simple prompts as a fallthrough for heavy tails. Might save more cost with near-zero quality impact on small turns.
elaine.cs: Good idea. Plan will include two fallback tiers: primary fallback open-3b, secondary open-1.5b for <64-token responses.
ravi.se: Implementing routing rules: weight 5% q8, 95% baseline; fallback rules and token-length-based routing. ETA prep 6h.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled in prod: Thu 10:00 PST. Monitoring configured: p50/p95, errors, QA probes, cost/tokens.
elaine.cs: We'll collect survey feedback + NPS snippet and reconvene after 48h. Marta to post eval results by Thu 08:00 PST.
marta.ml: Eval complete: quality delta 0.8% (within threshold). Latency p50 improved 26%, cost per token -33%. Canary green.
ravi.se: Canary started 10:00 PST, monitoring live. Auto-rollback disabled for manual review if any alert arises.
ken.aceroops: Early telemetry looks good. We'll capture user survey and internal CS notes for renewal pack.
ava.cs: Added to renewal playbook. If final 48h holds, recommend recommending dedicated reserved capacity for Acero to lock-in latency and cost predictability.
elaine.cs: :thumbsup: Thanks team — reconvene post-48h for final decision and closure notes.
metadata_notes: proactive quantization + model fallback routing canary for onboarding health; includes eval plan, timeline, rollout gates, and renewal tie-in
